profile_text.body:
Larsen & Toubro is a public company headquartered in Mumbai, India, operating in engineering, procurement and construction, hi-tech manufacturing, and services. Its site describes work across construction, energy, and sustainability, with customers in more than 50 countries. The company says it employs more than 50,000 professionals worldwide, that its workforce has an average age of 35 years, and that it stands on a legacy of over eight decades. It also describes itself as leading in nearly every sphere of business it operates in, and as consistently rated among the best employers in the country.

On environmental goals, the company states it aims to reach carbon neutrality by 2040, ahead of the Paris Agreement deadline of 2050, and water neutrality by 2035. It says sustainability is embedded in its vision, culture, strategy, and business processes, and that it integrates environment, social and governance principles across its business. It also describes employee volunteering programmes in which staff teach children, mentor students, plant trees, and take part in beach clean-ups.

The material reviewed does not describe AI-specific products or services, and no lawsuits or other litigation are recorded. The company is also listed under the aliases L&T and Larsen and Toubro.
